source: PC Night of the Hunter: the dog whistle is an inventory item from the hall's chest of drawers, used from the kitchen while the neighbour is at the record player (Steam guide 2584421942; Badinfos' run, lap 2). The mobile has no whistle — its Dog is a Zone06 Alerter. PC thermometer: the level's angrytime=240 in the PC data (level_hunter/level.xml, 1/20 s ticks) is the 12.0 s the mercury takes to drain from full — tools/pcref/thermo.py measured the same off the video; PCThermometerDrain 8.33 %/s is the HUD's drawing rate only, the tick meter keeps the mobile data's AngryMeterDecay (docs/PC_FIDELITY.md §7).

InventoryItems.DescriptionString: Only the dog hears it. The neighbour hears the dog.
